answer: At dawn each day, unproven identities lose standing unless renewed by fresh useful work, so stockpiled Sybils decay before they can vote. Entry runs through a harbor: a newcomer must dock with a sponsor who stakes reputation and funds, forfeited if the newcomer cheats. Trust then grows like a vine along verified work edges — each completed job lets the agent branch to new counterparties, but a branch snaps if either side is caught fabricating, cutting off whole clone clusters at once.
